title: RECORD (runner → adapter)
description: One record handed to a non-source adapter (SPEC.md §5). `fields` is exactly the projection of the adapter's `needs` (or of the step's `uses:`, ADR-004) — nothing more. The runner always canonicalizes and sends `key`; sources never receive this message.

fields.description: Projection of the step's needs/uses. Omitted when the projection is empty.
